description: This file defines a Kotlin interface for network communication with an astrology-related API, using Retrofit. It includes the declaration of a service interface with a single method for fetching daily astrology data, as well as a data class representing the response structure.

classes.name: AstrologyResponse
classes.description: Data class representing the astrology API response, including date, raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, and optional notes.

methods.name: getDailyAstrology
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves daily astrology data for a given date and timezone from the API.
